design.status: Four added 2x6 sloped principals with aligned posts — NOT build-ready
design.description: Four additional 2x6 sloped principals and aligned single 2x10 posts replace the middle horizontal rails. Top and bottom rails and the header remain. The horizontal plywood seam is unsupported between principals. Ordinary panel screws remain; no reduction in required gusset strength is established. Previous floor and strength screens do not qualify this revised layout.
